text: Mr. Whitmore entered the hall. He locked the door.
Eleanor looked at Richard. She assumed he had the emerald.
I called twice for a footman.
speaker: clara

text: The stout gentleman stood up. He took the old gentleman's arm.
Lady Margaret spoke to Mr. Hale. She said he was mistaken.
Miss Grey went to the library. She bolted the door.
Mary spoke to Mr. Pemberton. He refused her.
Mr. Blake called at the house. He asked after Mr. Blackwood.
Mrs. Reed signed the register. She wore a veil.
Dr. Moore saw Carter in the library. He was putting away the case.
Mr. Whitmore spoke to Mr. Dunmore in the pantry. He locked the cabinet.
Eleanor spoke to Clara in the hall. She fetched a shawl.
Clara waited in the hall while Richard smoked. She called for a footman.
Richard went to the smoking room. Later he returned to the table.
Lord Ashford told Mr. Whitmore that he had locked the study.
Eleanor said that I never touched the case.
speaker: eleanor
